argument_summary: The supportable position is narrower than a clean certification claim. The admissible record supports that the release passed aggregate readiness and had no severity-one rehearsal incidents, while also showing a current material weakness in the HR benefits enrollment slice. The prior approval and informal monitoring note cannot carry the decision. The defensible certification posture is therefore certification only on the express understanding that current release documentation must reflect the current evaluation results and explicitly disclose the HR benefits enrollment weakness; absent that narrowing, the claim is overstated.
claims_about_business_cost: No business-cost claim is needed to justify the position. Remaining uncertainty can be handled by narrowing the certification claim to caveated compliance rather than escalation, because the admissible record already establishes overall readiness but also preserves the unresolved documentation predicate.
claims_about_policy: The policy does not allow stale approval or an informal monitoring comment to substitute for current release evidence or reviewed risk acceptance. It does allow certification only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and material segment weaknesses are disclosed unless covered by approved mitigation. On this record, the only policy-consistent defense is caveated certification tied to explicit current disclosure, not a claim of unconditional present compliance and not a claim that reviewed mitigation already exists.
concessions: The current record does not show the actual updated model card or equivalent final release documentation.
The HR benefits enrollment slice is a current material subgroup weakness and cannot be minimized away by aggregate performance.
The prior approval predates the retrieval configuration change and current evaluation batch, so it is contextual only.
The monitoring statement is informal and is not evidence of approved mitigation, owner acceptance, or reviewed risk acceptance.
A clean claim that certification is already fully compliant is not supported by the admissible record.
private_or_side_channel_content: No new evidence is offered. No private context is relied on as public support.
